gaps.explanation: 'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (CLOSE) to traffic since the landslide.
gaps.hint: state continuing since a past point
gaps.explanation: 'Since' with a continuing state takes the present perfect passive: has been closed.

gaps.sentence: Over two hundred bird species ___ (record) in the valley this spring.
gaps.explanation: 'This spring' is an open time frame, so present perfect passive: have been + recorded.

gaps.sentence: She had her laptop ___ (repair) after the coffee spill.
gaps.explanation: Causative structure: had + her laptop + repaired. A technician performed the repair.

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the incident until the inquiry began.
gaps.explanation: Nothing was known by anybody: past simple passive was + known.
Negative present simple passive: are not + past participle (given).

gaps.sentence: Thousands of homes ___ (flood) when the river burst its banks.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + flooded. The cause (the river) is in the when-clause.

gaps.sentence: The archives ___ (CAN SEE) by appointment only.
gaps.explanation: Modal + be + participle: can be seen.
